title: data for business.allowance_warning and business.allowance_reached
description: A business (customer) used 80% (business.allowance_warning) or 100% (business.allowance_reached) of the monthly allowance set by the integrator. Usage = Meshio charges of the business's messages (sent and delivered + new inbound, including charges pending for balance) plus sends awaiting delivery, in the calendar month of America/Sao_Paulo; number fees do not count. Each event is sent at most once per business per month (crossing both thresholds at once sends only business.allowance_reached); changing the allowance re-arms the thresholds that end up above the usage. While reached, POST /v1/messages for the business's channels answers 402 BUSINESS_ALLOWANCE_REACHED; inbound messages keep being received. Envelope business_id = the business; channel_id is null.

used_micros.description: Usage in the month. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

allowance_micros.description: Monthly allowance. Integer string in micros.

percent.description: floor(used / allowance * 100); may exceed 100 (inbound messages are always charged).

resets_at.description: First day of the next month (YYYY-MM-DD), when usage resets.
